text: Another cupboard. I keep finding these. I did not build them, which I find more upsetting than if I had.
You are inside a wall. I would like to be clear that the wall is not part of the test, and neither is whatever is written on it.
That is not the cell. It is a different cell. Nobody is in it. Please do not wave at it.
That room is behind the wall. Walls do not have rooms behind them. I have checked. I am going to check again.
You have found a ledge. It is not on my plans. I will record it as a ledge that nobody found.
That is a storeroom. It stores nothing. I have been very clear that storerooms store things.
